answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, released only after three unrelated confirmations, no identity may audit its own recruit. The garden of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The kernel is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the haven.
